import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OLD = ROOT.parent / 'llmx-cpu-prefill-callback'
PRIOR = ROOT

def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(message)

def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def fnv(data):
    value = 14695981039346656037
    for byte in data:
        value = ((value ^ byte) * 1099511628211) & ((1 << 64) - 1)
    return format(value, 'x')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = args.output.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    report = {'status': 'preparing', 'runs': [], 'pairs': [],
              'scope': 'Fresh production vs enabled per-callback witness, two internal iterations for both models and primary/followup1/followup9. No performance acceptance; saved witness timings include diagnostic overhead.'}
    def save():
        (out / 'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='ascii')
    try:
        original = json.loads((OLD / 'plan.json').read_text())
        tokens = Path(original['tokens'])
        require(sha(tokens) == original['tokens_sha256'], 'Pinned tokens changed')
        files = [ROOT / name for name in ['run-followup.py', 'followup-witness.cpp', 'callback-witness.hpp', 'witness.hpp',
                 'followup-witness.exe', 'timing-control.exe', 'timing-model.cpp', 'build-followup.bat', 'build-followup.stdout', 'build-followup.stderr']]
        files += [tokens, OLD / 'plan.json']
        files += [p for p in (PRIOR / 'candidate/src').rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
        files += [p for p in (PRIOR / 'control/src').rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
        report['manifest'] = {str(path): sha(path) for path in files}
        for model in original['models']:
            require(sha(Path(model['path'])) == model['sha256'], 'Pinned model changed')
            report['manifest'][model['path']] = model['sha256']
        report['status'] = 'running'
        save()
        for model in original['models']:
            for workload, pp in [('primary', 215), ('followup1', 1), ('followup9', 9)]:
                vectors = {}
                for arm in ['production', 'prefill']:
                    name = model['name'] + '-' + workload + '-' + arm
                    binary = ROOT / ('timing-control.exe' if arm == 'production' else 'followup-witness.exe')
                    vector = out / (name + '.f32')
                    argv = [str(binary), model['path'], str(tokens), str(vector), arm, workload]
                    row = {'model': model['name'], 'workload': workload, 'arm': arm, 'argv': argv, 'status': 'running'}
                    report['runs'].append(row)
                    save()
                    try:
                        result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, timeout=600)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
                        (out / (name + '.stdout')).write_bytes(error.stdout or b'')
                        (out / (name + '.stderr')).write_bytes(error.stderr or b'')
                        row['status'] = 'timeout_owned_child_terminated'
                        save()
                        raise
                    (out / (name + '.stdout')).write_bytes(result.stdout)
                    (out / (name + '.stderr')).write_bytes(result.stderr)
                    row.update(exit_code=result.returncode, status='validating',
                               stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(), stderr_sha256=hashlib.sha256(result.stderr).hexdigest())
                    save()
                    require(result.returncode == 0, 'Model process failed: ' + name)
                    actual = json.loads(result.stdout)
                    require(actual['mode'] == arm and actual['workload'] == workload and actual['threads'] == 6 and
                            actual['ubatch'] == 128 and actual['pp_tokens'] == pp and actual['tg_tokens'] == 32 and actual['vocab'] == 151936,
                            'Wrong invocation metadata')
                    require([r['run'] for r in actual['records']] == [0, 1], 'Wrong internal iterations')
                    data = vector.read_bytes()
                    require(len(data) == 151936 * 4 and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in struct.unpack('<151936f', data)), 'Invalid full vector')
                    require(all(r['final_fnv64'] == fnv(data) for r in actual['records']), 'Warmup/final hash mismatch')
                    vectors[arm] = data
                    row.update(result=actual, vector_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())
                    if arm == 'prefill':
                        count = 2 if workload == 'primary' else 4
                        witness = actual['witness']
                        require(witness['applies'] == witness['restores'] == count * 6 and witness['caller_applies'] == count,
                                'Wrong whole-process placement count')
                        require(all(witness[k] == 0 for k in ['errors', 'active_after_decode', 'outside_prefill_setters']), 'Placement errors or incomplete restoration')
                        require(sorted(x for x in witness['per_cpu_applies'] if x) == [count] * 6, 'Unstable target mapping')
                        callbacks = actual['callback_witness']
                        phases = ['suffix'] if workload == 'primary' else ['prefix', 'suffix']
                        require([(c['run'], c['phase']) for c in callbacks] == [(run, phase) for run in [0, 1] for phase in phases], 'Wrong callback order/count')
                        for callback in callbacks:
                            require(callback['applies'] == callback['restores'] == 6 and callback['caller_applies'] == 1, 'Per-callback counts failed')
                            require(len(callback['cpus']) == len(set(callback['cpus'])) == 6 and
                                    len(callback['physical_cores']) == len(set(callback['physical_cores'])) == 6,
                                    'Per-callback physical core uniqueness failed')
                    row['status'] = 'pass'
                    save()
                require(vectors['production'] == vectors['prefill'], 'Fresh production/candidate vector differs: ' + name)
                report['pairs'].append({'model': model['name'], 'workload': workload, 'finite_floats_exact': 151936,
                                        'vector_sha256': hashlib.sha256(vectors['production']).hexdigest()})
                save()
        require(len(report['runs']) == 12 and len(report['pairs']) == 6, 'Incomplete followup gate')
        require(all(sha(Path(path)) == digest for path, digest in report['manifest'].items() if not path.endswith('.gguf')), 'Source/binary/input changed during gate')
        report.update(status='pass', all_owned_jobs_terminal=True, total_verified_callbacks=20,
                      total_apply_restore_each=120, exact_pair_floats=911616)
        save()
    except BaseException as error:
        report.update(status='failed', error=repr(error), all_owned_jobs_terminal=True)
        save()
        raise

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
